# Story artwork prompts

Generated using the built-in image-generation tool. User-supplied cartoon character and environment references were used; realistic-face drafts were discarded. Scenes are illustrative, not documentary portraits or campus photographs.

## 0.png

Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a single full-bleed 16:9 website background illustration, highest resolution. Image 1 and image 2 are STYLE AND CHARACTER REFERENCES. Match their charming stylized faceted animated-film look: simple oval black eyes, angular spiky dark hair, smooth cartoon face, NO facial hair, NO realistic human face, NO resemblance to the previously generated realistic man. Keep the exact reference cartoon character identity. Environment: richly detailed Japanese-inspired coastal town, warm sunset, lanterns, finely crafted stylized materials, lush foliage, atmospheric distant mountains, luminous but crisp. INTRODUCTION: follow image 1's scene and composition closely. SAME cartoon boy character on left third, dark jacket ivory shirt backpack, smiling directly at camera with palm extended toward viewer inviting them along cobblestone harbor street. Wide town view to right. Remove/omit ALL reference browser chrome, panels, charts, cards, navigation, borders. NO text, logos, numbers or watermark. Artwork only, no webpage mockup. Polished environment detail with the reference's deliberately simple cartoon character. Composition designed for HTML text on the indicated quiet side; face fully in frame.
